cohort: A single male infant born at term who presented at 2 months of age with prolonged jaundice and symptoms of hypothyroidism.
finding: Severe congenital hypothyroidism can cause reversible renal impairment and elevated creatinine phosphokinase (CPK) levels, which both resolve with levothyroxine therapy.
followup_time: 4 months after birth (last observation was 2 months post-treatment initiation, when the infant was 4 months old)
